children.name: Geitonoplesium asperum Hook., 1832
children.description: Geitonoplesium is a genus in the family Asphodelaceae,  containing the sole species Geitonoplesium cymosum, commonly known as scrambling lily. The species  is a perennial evergreen scrambling vine found in rainforests, sclerophyll forests and woodlands of eastern Australia, and parts of Malesia and Melanesia.
